_comment: Per-seat copy for the result page (/seat/VIC/<District>). Every district works without an entry here: the hook falls back to default_hook_labor or default_hook_other, candidates come from data/candidates, towns from places.json. Add an entry to give a seat its own hook, a line per candidate on the transmission lines (stances, keyed by exact candidate name), or, after the ballot draw, the how-to-vote order (ballot: [{name, party}] top to bottom, Labor last). A seat with a ballot list switches to the numbered card.
default_hook_labor: Held by Labor. Their transmission lines were sold to Victorians at $3.9 billion. They're now up to $11.4 billion, and it lands on your power bill.
